description: This file is a JavaScript module that defines a web scraper function for the 'ambitiouskitchen.com' website. It uses cheerio for HTML parsing and puppeteerFetch for fetching web pages, extracting recipe details such as image, name, ingredients, instructions, and timing information.

classes.name: RecipeSchema
classes.description: A schema object for storing recipe details, including image, name, ingredients, instructions, timing, and servings.

methods.name: ambitiousKitchen
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and parses a recipe page from 'ambitiouskitchen.com', returning a structured recipe object or an error if not found.
